one_line: Indian cytogeneticist and botanist who advanced sugarcane breeding and plant conservation in the mid-20th century.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, slender and upright, with a calm, composed scholar’s presence.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium-brown South Indian complexion, slightly prominent nose, fine lines at the eyes, thoughtful sharp gaze; default expression is gentle but intensely focused, as if mid-observation.
appearance.hair: Smooth black hair with a few subtle greying strands, neatly parted in the middle and pulled back into a low, tight bun at the nape; no headwear, a few soft wisps at the temples.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid-20th-century Indian scientist’s attire: a crisp, elbow-sleeved white cotton blouse with a modest round neckline; over it, a handloom cotton saree in muted indigo blue with a thin off-white border, pleats neatly draped front and the pallu brought over her left shoulder and around her torso for modest coverage down to ankle-length; simple flat brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery—a small pair of round silver stud earrings and a thin silver wristwatch on her left hand; occasionally a folded khaki cardigan draped over one forearm to suggest British lab winters but not worn.
appearance.signature: A well-used dark brown leather field notebook held in her left hand, its pages stuffed with pressed plant specimens and sketched chromosome diagrams, and a slender metal lab magnifier hanging from a simple cord around her neck.

ref_desc: Janaki Ammal appears as a slender early-40s woman with an oval medium-brown face, middle-parted bun hairstyle, white blouse and indigo cotton saree, simple silver accessories, dark brown leather field notebook and neck magnifier, in an indigo, white and brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Janaki Ammal: a slender early-40s Indian woman with an oval medium-brown face, thoughtful sharp eyes, and black hair (slightly greying) parted in the middle and pulled into a low tight bun with a few soft wisps at the temples. She wears a crisp elbow-sleeved white cotton blouse and a neatly draped indigo blue handloom saree with a thin off-white border, its pleats sharp at the front and the pallu wrapped over her left shoulder and across her torso down to her ankles for modest, era-accurate coverage, paired with simple flat brown leather sandals. Show minimal jewellery—a small pair of round silver stud earrings and a thin silver wristwatch on her left wrist—plus a folded khaki cardigan resting over one forearm to hint at British lab winters. Her signature props are a well-used dark brown leather field notebook in her left hand, bulging slightly with pressed plant specimens and notes, and a slender metal lab magnifier hanging on a cord around her neck. Use an indigo, white, medium brown, silver and dark brown leather palette, and present her in a neutral stance that clearly displays her face, hairstyle, full costume and scientific tools from head to toe.
